mechanism: Alexander's campaigns in Persia and northwest India broke existing powers and left a political vacuum that Chandragupta exploited to seize the Mauryan throne.
Magadha's rise out of the Mahajanapadas system supplied the territorial base and administrative tradition from which the Mauryan state expanded.
Diadochi wars kept the Seleucid rulers occupied in the west, letting Chandragupta seize northwestern territories in the early third century BCE.
Habsburg dynasts won election to the imperial crown from 1273, and the Holy Roman office became the power base from which the dynasty expanded.
After the 1526 battle of Mohacs, Habsburg succession claims gave the dynasty the Hungarian crown, extending its rule into Central Europe.
Habsburg succession to the Bohemian crown after 1526 brought the kingdom under Habsburg dynastic rule for centuries.
Refugees fleeing the collapse of Roman authority and barbarian invasions settled the Venetian lagoons, founding the community that became the republic.
Justinian's Gothic War restored Byzantine administration over Italy and the lagoon settlements, shaping Venice's early ties to Constantinople.
Venetian shipping and naval power carried crusading armies and supplies, making Venice a central logistical partner of the Crusades.
Alarm over the 1962 standoff pushed the superpowers toward arms control, a process that culminated in the 1968 Non-Proliferation Treaty.
The 1966 ICCPR set out the UN human rights framework that the Convention on the Rights of the Child drew on for its rights standards.
Alfred the Great's defeat of Viking forces and consolidation of Wessex laid the groundwork for the later unification of the English kingdom.
Ottoman control of eastern Mediterranean trade routes after 1453 pushed Portugal to seek direct sea routes to Asia.
Koine Greek and Hellenistic Jewish communities supplied the linguistic and cultural networks through which early Christianity spread across the Mediterranean.
The Indo-Greek collapse in the northwest left a political vacuum that Kushan rulers filled, consolidating power in Bactria and northern India.
The 1688 Glorious Revolution settled a Protestant succession that made a constitutional union with Scotland politically feasible in 1707.
Marshall Plan aid tied Western European recovery to transatlantic cooperation, a framework that fed directly into the 1949 NATO security alliance.
The bomb programme created a nuclear arsenal and arms race between the superpowers that became the core military rivalry of the Cold War.
Los Alamos weapons work at the Manhattan Project laid the technical and institutional base from which thermonuclear weapons were developed.
